WITH filtered_dates AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT d_date_sk AS date_sk,
           d_year AS d_year,
           d_qoy AS d_qoy,
           d_moy AS d_moy
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_month_seq BETWEEN 1217 AND 1217 + 11
),
store_sales_selected AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT ss.ss_item_sk AS item_sk,
           ss.ss_store_sk AS store_sk,
           fd.d_year AS d_year,
           fd.d_qoy AS d_qoy,
           fd.d_moy AS d_moy,
           SUM(coalesce(ss.ss_sales_price * ss.ss_quantity, 0)) AS sumsales
    FROM filtered_dates AS fd
    INNER JOIN store_sales AS ss ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = fd.date_sk
    GROUP BY ss.ss_item_sk, ss.ss_store_sk, fd.d_year, fd.d_qoy, fd.d_moy
)
